pristine.sourcePolicy: repo-authored React declaration probes against vendored @solana/react 7.0.0

adapted.sourcePolicy: structurally equivalent Octane public probes after permitted transformations

permittedTransformations.rule: React probes import the pinned @solana/react package types; Octane probes import the package public entry
Octane probes may additionally assert createClientStore, createWalletStore, and createTransactionExecutor, which have no upstream React twin
Matching @ts-expect-error controls must reject the same invalid call shapes on both sides
